props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the control.

props.name: items
props.description: Options: `{ value, label?, disabled? }`.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value.

props.name: searchable
props.description: With `searchable={false}` the text input becomes read-only and the list always shows every option — a select-only combobox: the advanced Select (styled popup, per-option icons) without the autocomplete.

props.name: width
props.description: Width behaviour: `fixed` (default) uses `--ds-combobox-width` (16rem), `wrap` fits the longest option, `fill` takes 100% of the container.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the control.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the clear button.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — the selected option's value is submitted under it (via a hidden input).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Called when the input text changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the control.

props.name: items
props.description: Options. Each may carry a leading `icon`; with the search hidden, the control mirrors the selected option's icon.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: `v-model` value; takes precedence over `value` when bound.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value. `null` for none.

props.name: searchable
props.description: With `searchable: false` the input becomes read-only and the list always shows every option: a select-only combobox, the advanced Select (styled popup, per-option icons) without the autocomplete.

props.name: width
props.description: Width behaviour: `fixed` (default) uses `--ds-combobox-width`, `wrap` fits the longest option, `fill` takes 100% of the container.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder. Defaults to the catalog's "Search…".

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Clear button accessible name. Defaults to the catalog's "Clear".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Text shown when no option matches. Defaults to the catalog's "No results".
